description: Phone-shot amateur look — looks like a real person snapped it on their phone. Casual, candid, pore-level real, no professional gloss. Three flavors: digital phone, 35mm film point-and-shoot, or off-duty intimate. Returns the styled prompt stack for your shot and the aspect_ratio to make it at — pair it with generate_image and pass that aspect_ratio along.

aspect_ratio.description: Optional frame shape. Replaces the shape the style uses by default. The answer carries aspect_ratio: pass it to generate_image so the picture is made at that shape.

style.description: digital_phone = iPhone main camera snap, 9:16 vertical. film_pointshoot = Contax T2 35mm Portra 400. off_duty_intimate = natural-window editorial candor.

subject.description: What you want to shoot. E.g. "a woman walking through a hotel lobby" or "morning coffee on the balcony".
